name: Monster Keyboard RGB
description:
Keyboard RGB color and lighting effects in Quick Settings for the MONSTER TULPAR T7 V20.2 (Uniwill GK7MR0R) single-zone RGB keyboard.

REQUIRES the monster_kbd kernel driver and the monster-kbd-fx helper, which this extension does not install. Install them first from the GitHub page (sudo ./install-system.sh). Without them the toggle shows "Driver not loaded".

Effects: rainbow, breathing, fire, aurora, ocean, heartbeat, random, party, police, CPU load, CPU temperature, battery level. Static colors: 9 presets.

The keyboard is a single zone and the embedded controller accepts about two color changes per second, so there are no per-key or perfectly smooth effects.

Unofficial project, not affiliated with MONSTER or Uniwill. Only tested on the model above.
